season.evidence: Wallowa high country is open mid-July to late September (AP/Washington Times listing, SummitPost Matterhorn page); 213 of 223 logged Matterhorn ascents fall Jun-Sep, 213 in Jul-Sep. Technical west-face rock is climbed in the same snow-free window.

season.evidence: Same as West Face Chimney: snow-free window mid-July to late September (AP/Washington Times listing, logged-ascent histogram). Stored text imagines a winter mixed ascent but none is recorded.

missing.name: East Ridge from Ice Lake
missing.overview: The usual way up Matterhorn: trail to Ice Lake, then a climbers path and open slopes onto the east ridge and the summit. Most parties overnight at the lake; a single long day is possible. Late summer is the dependable window.
evidence: https://www.summitpost.org/matterhorn-oregon/150682 - east ridge via Ice Lake is the standard route

missing.name: Sacajawea-Matterhorn Ridge Traverse
missing.overview: A ridge link between the two highest summits of the Wallowas, with one false summit and a couple of exposed class 4 moves that can be avoided. Usually done from an Ice Lake camp.

notes: No track assigned: every harvested Matterhorn ascent is the Ice Lake walk-up / east ridge or the Sacajawea traverse, none the west-face rock routes, which are stored with no pins. Razzberry Mt. is Pt 9314 west of Craig Mountain, a different peak; the Matterhorn Peakbagger match fits only the West Face routes. The standard Matterhorn route is absent from allRoutesOnPeak.
